entities.name: Eelam Wars and 2004 Tsunami
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The successive Eelam Wars, LTTE suicide bombings, the Norwegian-brokered ceasefire of 2002, the devastating 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami killing 35,000 in Sri Lanka, and the ceasefire collapse.
